note: Landmarks and attractions along the route, not the organiser's official checkpoints - replace before the event if they differ.

checkpoints.name: MacRitchie Ranger Station
checkpoints.note: Toilets, drinking water and an AED

checkpoints.name: HSBC TreeTop Walk
checkpoints.note: 250 m suspension bridge between Bukit Peirce and Bukit Kallang

checkpoints.name: Bukit Kallang
checkpoints.note: High point of the route at the TreeTop Walk's far end

checkpoints.name: Petaling Boardwalk
checkpoints.note: Boardwalk down through Petaling Trail to Petaling Hut

checkpoints.name: Jelutong Tower
checkpoints.note: Seven-storey observation tower over the forest canopy

checkpoints.name: Syonan Jinja Ruins
checkpoints.note: Wartime Shinto shrine remains - a short detour off the path

checkpoints.name: Jering Hut
checkpoints.note: Shelter on the Jering Trail, with an AED

checkpoints.name: The Leaning Tree of MacRitchie
checkpoints.note: Landmark tree on the Chemperai Trail

checkpoints.name: Lim Bo Seng Memorial
checkpoints.note: War memorial and grave above the reservoir shore

checkpoints.name: MacRitchie Reservoir Park
checkpoints.note: Main park hub - cafe, toilets, water point and AED

checkpoints.name: Petai Trail Boardwalk
checkpoints.note: Last boardwalk stretch before the return to Windsor
